source: Thomas et al. 2019 Experiment 1 / Krajbich et al. 2010

validation.criteria: Per model: fast_rt_rate(<300ms)<=0.05; timeout_rate<=0.10; pathological_draw_fraction<=0.15; recorded_rt_coverage_fraction>=0.20 (hit_rate>=0.9 and median RT ratio 0.5-2.0)
notes: A passed diagnostic is not proof of optimal priors.
Simulation stochasticity in c_bifood uses libc rand and is not wholly controlled by NumPy seed.

mechanism_parameters: Keep each branch's original free/fixed theta, gamma and other parameters from run/fit_nn/food_equal/tools/model_info.py until explicitly revised.
pending: Before training, define a consistent RT observation model: existing load_food_data overwrites RT with sum of option fixation durations; original experimental RT includes extra intervals (mean about 355ms). The simulator has fixed ndt=0 and uses a fixation sequence with last fixation extended. Do not silently fit against inconsistent RT definitions.
